escena: SCENE (cinematic, epic, high-impact ensemble still, a vast dark operations hall at night with thin haze): a social care squad of three AT WORK during a campaign peak — PERSON 1 Antonio, PERSON 2 Karo and PERSON 3 Isabella, as in their references — stand in a short DIAGONAL that recedes into depth on the RIGHT side of the frame, all wearing the ROYAL-BLUE EFEONCE HOODIE exactly as in its reference. EVERYONE IS WORKING: nobody poses, nobody stands idle, no hand is in a pocket. Camera about eight meters away at chest height, 85mm f/5.6 so all three faces stay sharp, REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS, nothing foreshortened; framed from mid-thigh up; Antonio's head is about one seventh of the frame height and a clear band of darkness stays above it. GEOGRAPHY: Antonio is nearest; his face is at about 68 % of the frame width. Karo is one step behind him and to the right, her near shoulder hidden behind his, her face at about 79 %. Isabella is one more step behind and to the right, her near shoulder hidden behind Karo's, her face at about 89 %. From the left edge of the frame to 52 % of the frame width there is nobody and nothing lit. THE COMMENTS ARE PHYSICAL OBJECTS OF LIGHT, NOT ICONS: each one is a small three-dimensional speech-bubble shape of frosted glass lit from inside, like a soft glowing pebble with a tiny tail, each a slightly different size and tilt, with real bloom, real depth of field and motion in the air; they are BLANK — no dots, no symbols, no letters inside — and they never line up like a row of interface icons. THE PHENOMENON: far behind them, some thirty meters back and only in the right third of the frame, a TOWERING WAVE of thousands of these bubbles rises like a tide, dim cool azure (#0375DB), anonymous and melted out of focus; its crest peaks above their heads between 80 % of the frame width and the right edge. From the wave ONE loose stream of dim azure, still-unanswered bubbles curves down through the haze, always BEHIND the three of them and never in front of anybody, and ends hidden behind Antonio's back; the orange bubble at his fingertip is the one that has just come round his shoulder. ANTONIO ACTS, and his action is the centre of the picture: his right arm — the arm nearest the left edge of the frame — is bent with the elbow LOW and tucked against his ribs, the forearm rising in front of his own shoulder, hand at the height of his chin and about 30 cm in front of his body, index finger extended. Neither his elbow nor his hand goes farther left than the outline of that shoulder: Antonio's frame-left shoulder is the leftmost lit thing in the picture and nothing — no arm, no bubble, no glow — is to the left of it. HIS FINGERTIP IS TOUCHING one bubble about the size of his fist that hangs in front of the outer edge of that shoulder, on the side of his chest opposite the embroidered mark. That bubble is saturated orange (#FF6500): the comment being answered at this very instant, the only accent in the frame. It is a point of colour, not a lamp: it glows dimmer than the white bubbles and lights nothing around it except a thin warm edge on his fingertip; no orange reaches his face, his beard, the hoodie or the haze. Directly below his hand hangs a short vertical trail of THREE answered bubbles, clear cool white: the first just under his wrist, the second at the height of his elbow, the third a little lower, each smaller and softer than the one before, the last one still well above the desk; the trail stays in front of that same arm and never moves left of the shoulder line. His other arm hangs relaxed at his side, the hand empty, half hidden by the desk. His head stays almost frontal, turned only a few degrees toward his raised hand; HIS EYES ARE ON THE ORANGE BUBBLE at his fingertip, a little below his eye line and a little to its side, so his gaze drops only slightly: both eyes and both eyebrows fully visible, each iris a full circle with white on both sides, upper eyelids clearly above the irises, a catchlight in each eye; focused, sure of himself, the hint of a closed-mouth smile. KARO ACTS: she holds a plain matte black phone in both hands at stomach height, thumbs mid-tap, screen turned away from the camera; ONE answered white bubble, smaller than Antonio's, has just left her phone and hangs just BELOW her hands, a little nearer the camera, soft at the edges. Her head is almost frontal with the chin slightly down and she looks at her phone with her crooked, playful half-smile, eyelids lowered but both irises still visible under the lashes. ISABELLA ACTS: she holds her own matte black phone in both hands at stomach height, thumbs lifted off it, the message just sent, screen turned away from the camera; ONE answered white bubble has already drifted a hand-width BELOW her hands and toward the camera, larger and more out of focus than Karo's. She looks down at it with an open, energetic smile, eyelids lowered but both irises still visible under the lashes. Nothing glows between any phone and any chin. THIS SCENE DECIDES THE GAZE and replaces any other gaze instruction in this prompt: Antonio looks at the orange bubble at his fingertip; Karo and Isabella look down at their own hands; nobody looks into the lens, nobody looks at anybody else. No hand, arm, phone or bubble covers the embroidered mark on any chest: the three marks stay fully visible. The only bubbles that overlap a body above the waist are Antonio's orange one and its trail, all on his frame-left side, away from his mark. The only white bubbles in the frame are Antonio's trail of three and the single one below each woman's hands; every other bubble is the dim azure of the wave and its stream. LIGHT: the answered white bubbles are the only key light. Antonio's face is lit cool white from low on his frame-left side by the first bubble of his trail, the frame-right side of his face falling into shadow; Karo and Isabella are each lit cool white from below and in front by the bubble under their own hands, the forehead and the far cheek a little darker; every pair of eyes stays readable; the light of the identity references does NOT carry over; a faint azure rim from the wave behind separates their hair and shoulders from the dark. The phone screens are never visible and add no light. A long dark matte operations desk runs between the camera and them, its near edge just in front of the lens; its top is matte black and non-reflective and no bubble touches it. The wave, the stream, the trail and every bubble stay inside the RIGHT half of the frame and never cross a face. The left of the frame is one towering matte black wall of the hall, unlit, that ends in a clean vertical edge at about 46 % of the frame width, well behind Antonio; no bubble, no glow, no lamp and no point of light is on the wall. The haze only glows softly around the wave and the stream; there are NO shafts, beams or columns of light anywhere and nothing comes down from above. Rich contrast, deep navy blacks, real sensor grain, genuine depth of field. No warm light apart from that single orange bubble, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos of any other brand.
